name: Astah SysMLv2 Editor
description: A Visual Studio Code extension for authoring SysML v2 textual notation with syntax highlighting, diagnostics, navigation, outline views, and automatic diagram generation.
editorialNote: Added from NeoMBSE's 2026-10-23 coverage audit. This is a separate offering from legacy Astah products and its files are not data-compatible with them.
classificationNotes: A valid Astah SysML, Astah System Safety, or faculty site license is required after the 20-day trial.
Automatic diagram generation is not the same as direct graphical editing.
The editor is not data-compatible with legacy Astah products.
